abilities.name: flash-fire
abilities.effect: Protects against fire moves.  Once one has been blocked, the Pokémon's own Fire moves inflict 1.5× damage until it leaves battle.

abilities.name: drought
abilities.effect: Summons strong sunlight that lasts indefinitely upon entering battle.

kanto.flavorText: When it is born, it has just one snow- white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

original-johto.flavorText: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxur­ ious coat of fur.

hoenn.flavorText: It can freely control fire, making fiery orbs fly like will-o’-the-wisps. Just before evolution, its six tails grow hot as if on fire.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

updated-johto.flavorText: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

original-unova.flavorText: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

updated-unova.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

kalos.flavorText: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Inside Vulpix’s body burns a flame that never goes out. During the daytime, when the temperatures rise, this Pokémon releases flames from its mouth to prevent its body from growing too hot.

original-alola.flavorText: From its mouth spew flames that seem to resemble the spirits of the deceased. Some people mistakenly think this fire is a ghost.

updated-alola.flavorText: It manipulates balls of fire to catch its prey. If you raise one from when it’s young, it will grow close to you like a puppy Pokémon.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.

swsh.flavorText: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

freeTextEntries: Grand Underground - Spacious Cave, Volcanic Cave, Sandsear Cave, Typhlo Cavern (After obtaining the National Pokédex) (Kantonian Form) | Unobtainable (Alolan Form)

pla.flavorText: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

freeTextEntries: Cobalt Coastlands: Veilstone Cape, massive mass outbreaks (Kantonian Form) | Alabaster Icelands: massive mass outbreaks (Kantonian Form) | Alabaster Icelands: Whiteout Valley (only one during Request 83) (Alolan Form)
